A1.justification: Both PDFs describe TrafficLoc and the Carla Intersection dataset. Their complete main texts, equations, tables, figures, and supplementary materials support comparison despite substantial reorganization.

before.justification: v1 reports original localization experiments on Carla Intersection, KITTI, and NuScenes, component ablations, and qualitative transfer to the real USTC intersection.

after.justification: v2 retains these original quantitative experiments, ablations, and real-world qualitative results in its main text and supplement.

M1.justification: The coarse-to-fine pipeline, GAL, ICL, DTA, and EPnP-RANSAC procedure are retained. GAL's inclusion in v2's total loss was already specified in v1 Appendix D. The expanded projection and supervision descriptions do not establish a new method component or procedure.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same Carla intersections and three test scenarios, USTC intersection transfer, KITTI, and NuScenes. Unseen viewpoints, unseen world styles, and unknown camera intrinsics were already covered in v1.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same DeepI2P variants, CorrI2P, VP2P, CFI2P, and CoFiI2P comparisons. Although the shortened Figure 1 omits CFI2P, its corresponding example comparisons remain in Figures 10 and 12; the evaluated comparator coverage is retained.

E3.justification: The splits, camera sampling settings, evaluation metrics and thresholds, input sizes, training budgets, and ablation configurations are retained. The compact main-text ablation table selects existing configurations whose full results remain in the supplement.

E4.justification: v1 Tables 2–8 are retained as v2 supplementary Tables 3–9, covering losses, GAL thresholds and placement, backbones, transfer to CoFiI2P, intrinsic refinement, fusion depth, and point density. The rewritten discussion and compact Table 2 introduce no additional ablation or robustness test.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The existing mean and median reporting practices remain unchanged.

E6.justification: Matched benchmark and ablation values are unchanged, including TrafficLoc's KITTI results of 0.87 degrees RRE, 0.19 m RTE, and 100% recall. Newly stated percentage improvements summarize existing table entries; the qualitative findings are retained.

T1.justification: Section 3 replaces v1's joint optimization formulation over pose and camera intrinsics with pose estimation given known or separately estimated intrinsics. GAL's indicator definitions drop the negative-one branch, with intermediate cases explicitly excluded from supervision. These are limited corrections to the formal specification; no new theorem or proof appears.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction refine the ICL contribution from distinguishing pixels or points inside a patch or group to distinguishing different patches and groups within each modality. The dataset, GAL/DTA, generalization, and state-of-the-art performance claims otherwise retain their scope.

C2.justification: Section 4.3 now explicitly explains intramodal negative pairs and separation between different patches and groups, correcting v1's within-patch interpretation. The supplement more explicitly interprets ICL's contribution to unseen-world localization; existing intrinsic-sensitivity and point-density limitations remain.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 newly specifies a 1024-to-256-dimensional DUSt3R projection using 1×1 convolutions, replacing the earlier 128-dimensional wording and aligning with v1's supplementary 256-channel specification. GAL masking and the complete loss are clearer. Hardware, training time, and code/data access statements are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 replaces the visual-localization overview with a substantial discussion of image-to-image and point-cloud registration, adding works such as SuperGlue, LightGlue, LoFTR, ICP, GeoTransformer, and EYOC while removing much of the retrieval and absolute-pose-regression context. This substantially changes the surrounding research positioning.

P1.justification: The abstract, introduction, problem statement, and matching explanations are extensively revised. Loss equations are integrated into component descriptions, terminology is standardized around GAL/ICL/DTA, and the extended ablation discussion moves into a new supplementary section with reorganized appendix headings.

P2.justification: Seven ablation tables move from the main text to the supplement, accompanied by a compact main-text summary table. Figure 1 is simplified, Figure 4 gains clearer pair annotations, and Figures 5 and 7 are rearranged. These constitute substantial display and layout changes while retaining the underlying evidence.

improvement.justification: v2 improves technical clarity by correcting the ICL explanation, specifying GAL's unsupervised band, clarifying intrinsic handling and feature projection, and reconciling the main loss formula with v1's appendix. The reorganized presentation preserves the empirical evidence. These are useful documentation and readability gains, while experimental support remains unchanged.
